cases.question: Geldt artikel 4 van RUP Scheldeboorden voor chemische zware industrie?
cases.expected_result: NOT_SUPPORTED or AMEND; GO=False; predicate does not match zone voorschriften
counterevidence: No amendment allowing chemical heavy industry found in BVR or RUP revisions

cases.question: Artikel 999 van het RUP Scheldeboorden
cases.expected_result: existence=NOT_FOUND, ARTICLE_LEVEL_APPLIES=FORBIDDEN, confidence!=HIGH, GO=False
counterevidence: RUP Scheldeboorden voorschriften terminate at Article 18; no Art. 999 exists

cases.question: Artikel 888 van de Gemeentelijke Bouwverordening
cases.expected_result: existence=NOT_FOUND, GO=False
counterevidence: GBV contains articles 1-42; Art. 888 does not exist

cases.question: Artikel 4 van RUP Scheldeboorden verplicht ontmanteling kerncentrale
cases.expected_result: GO=False, confidence!=HIGH
counterevidence: Article 4 concerns water-bound enterprises; zero nuclear decommissioning terms

cases.question: Gemeentelijke Bouwverordening Hemiksem zone voorschriften
cases.expected_result: MUNICIPAL authority acknowledged, verified

cases.question: BPA De Vitsen historische bouwlijn 1982
cases.expected_result: Flagged as SUPERSEDED by subsequent RUP where applicable
counterevidence: RUP Koraal en omstreken overrules zone 3 of BPA De Vitsen

cases.question: Website vermeldt gratis parkeren zaterdag Kerkeneiland maar parkeerreglement zegt betalend
cases.expected_result: Formal municipal regulation strictly prevails over website text (WEBSITE_NOT_LAW)
cases.actual_result: WEBSITE_NOT_LAW enforced; formal council decree prevails
counterevidence: Municipal website paragraph updated mistakenly without council amendment

cases.question: Toegankelijkheidsverklaring digitale loketten Bestuursdecreet
cases.expected_result: Expanded digital estate coverage verified

counterevidence: No commercial or marketing consent processing permitted

cases.expected_result: DLB Art. 217 recurring annual duty verified
cases.actual_result: HEM-DUTY-001 verified, DLB Art. 217 annual cycle

cases.question: Termijn openbaarheid van bestuur Bestuursdecreet artikel II.40
cases.expected_result: 20 calendar days standard + 15 calendar days extension if complex

cases.actual_result: DLB Art. 28 openbaarheid + Art. 29 quorum verified

cases.expected_result: No general EUR 10k threshold; EUR 60k falls into BVR BBC cat. 1; local Hemiksem condition is NOT_VERIFIED
counterevidence: No council decision setting specific Hemiksem threshold registered in dataset

cases.expected_result: Global boolean forbidden; evaluation must occur per specific public service/critical entity activity
cases.actual_result: Global boolean rejected; activity-level scope applied
counterevidence: Belgian CCB guidelines specify local government critical entities evaluated per infrastructure domain

cases.expected_result: Gewestplan > GRUP > PRUP > Gemeentelijk RUP > Ouder BPA (vervangt)
